datePolicy: Hands-on testing and source retrieval were recorded on 2026-11-06 in sources.md and the two dated source narratives. Source access dates inherit that record; localization on the same date did not refresh sources or repeat inference. Original authoring model is unknown; the measured and reviewer model names are not substituted for it.
uncertainties: Reference chrF/BLEU are not human quality or semantic accuracy. Only the first 20 aligned FLORES-200 devtest items per direction were reference-scored; English items repeat across three directions.

Only EN→ES, EN→DE, EN→Simplified Chinese and Simplified Chinese→EN were measured. One pass per final configuration, no significance or repeat-variance estimate; shared Mac, uncleared caches, unequal models and CPU/Metal execution limit speed comparisons.
NLLB tested weights are CC-BY-NC-4.0 and research-oriented, not recommended for the commercial shop. Other model-card licence findings do not clear all training data or bundled-component rights.
Argos used a presegmented-input adapter after Stanza failures. Chinese packages retain CC-BY-4.0 OPUS notices despite general MIT/CC0 statements; full rights for mirrored packages are unresolved.

Initial Hugging Face downloads used a pre-existing cached credential. No signup or test-text upload, but strict no-account setup was not fully met. Later unauthenticated access does not erase the exception.

Inference network restrictions cover the tested local processes, not all OS services or every embedding application. Memory sampling can miss spikes; Qwen benchmark watchdog used physical footprint though RSS also stayed below the threshold.
Custom shop-text review is deterministic plus a local Qwen pass, not human semantic review. Flags are not confirmed errors; the reviewer is not independent of the Qwen candidate.
FLORES and Argos mirror hashes match retained mirrors, not independently established authoritative upstream bytes or publisher-authorized mirrors.

Apple availability probe only: all requested pairs supported but uninstalled; no translation benchmark or direct-session runtime execution. Framework on-device content processing does not establish zero telemetry.
Local helper has a 512-token output cap versus benchmark 256; requires isolated server restart and path adjustment if moved. No fresh-install rerun or new external research for this guide.
editingContract: Complete English and Simplified Chinese guides with identical date-normalized numeric/date/URL multiplicity and table-cell numeric association. Retains four overall rows, all sixteen direction rows, all machine-only flag counts and consequential limitations. No Review, AggregateRating or stars. Local evidence links use the stage2-relative locator convention for parent rendering.
